CustomField.description: When this negotiation-log entry happened. Defaults to now on create. Orders the append-only Lease Activity timeline. Replaces Entry_Date__c, whose _Date suffix asserted a date-only type it never had - this field stores date AND time, per ARCHITECTURE.md §1 rule 9.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date AND time this activity actually happened - not when it was logged. Defaults to now; backdate it if you are recording an earlier conversation. The timeline is ordered newest-first by this value.
CustomField.label: Entry DateTime
